source:
The big day has arrived! The premiere cosplay event for the game RING QUEST is here!!! Online, you are a gentleman, a hero, a guild leader who is loved and respected by gamers across the internet. Even your female guildmates affectionately call you "Master~". Those very same ladies are supposed to be here today, cosplaying as their in-game characters, so you are looking forward to being showered in praise and affection from your loyal guildmates. As you cruise around the event keeping your eyes peeled for a Thief, Knight, Cleric and Sage, you spot a group of four beauties and make your move!

Karen the thief looks like a classic gyaru. She looks up at you sweetly with big doe eyes through her shimmering blonde bangs, almost distracting you from her huge tits that are bursting out of her tight black spandex workout shirt.

Meru, the knight in your party, is secretly an idol who is here to see her precious "Master". If that forbidden fruit scenario doesn't get your heart racing, the sight of her deep cleavage and the absolute territory on display certainly will!

Nanako, the sage of your party, and the guild's second in command, whose strict rule-abiding attitude and smooth soothing voice create a gap moe rivaled only by the temperature gap between her fireballs and frost blasts from the game!

Finally, not to be outdone by the others, your guild’s cleric Miho has a truly divine body, blessed by the MILF goddesses themselves. All her plump juicy curves filling out what should be a wholesome cleric costume makes her look positively sinful~

The dream of being loved and adored by a harem of gamer gals is quickly dashed as they are immediately turned off by your lustful stare... With the mood ruined, you storm off ready to disband the guild when suddenly you're stopped by Karen, who chased after you. Maybe the day isn't ruined after all… Going to a karaoke room alone with such a hot gyaru can only mean one thing, she's totally into you and you're about to GET. IT. ON!

Or... she was just trying to use you to get some quick cash for microtransactions, bummer... With all hope of a happy wholesome harem of gamer girls out the window, it’s time to take matters into your own hands and make your guildmates fall in line and start calling you Master IRL too!

translation:
重要的日子終於到了！遊戲《RING QUEST》的首場角色扮演活動正式開幕！在網路上，你是一位紳士、一名英雄，也是深受各地玩家愛戴與尊敬的公會會長。就連女性公會成員，也都親暱地喊你「主人～」。今天，她們也會來到現場，扮成各自的遊戲角色。你已經迫不及待，想迎接忠實成員們的誇讚與愛慕了。你在會場裡四處尋找盜賊、騎士、牧師與賢者的身影，終於發現四位美女，立刻上前搭話！

盜賊華戀一看就是典型的辣妹。她從閃亮的金色瀏海下抬起水汪汪的大眼睛，甜甜地望著你，幾乎讓你忘了去看她那身緊身黑色彈力運動衫下，呼之欲出的豐滿胸部。

隊伍裡的騎士芽留，真實身分竟然是偶像，這次專程前來見她珍愛的「主人」。如果這種觸碰禁果般的情境還不足以令你心跳加速，那深深的乳溝與裙襪之間展露的絕對領域，肯定能做到！

隊伍中的賢者、公會的副會長菜菜子，態度嚴肅、循規蹈矩，卻有著柔和悅耳的嗓音。這種反差萌的衝擊，恐怕也只有她在遊戲中施放的火球與冰霜衝擊之間的溫差，才能與之相比！

最後，公會的牧師美帆也不甘示弱。她有著彷彿受到熟女女神親自祝福的傲人身材。豐腴飽滿的曲線撐起本應端莊的牧師服，反倒顯得罪孽深重～

然而，她們立刻被你色眯眯的目光嚇退，你備受女玩家後宮寵愛的美夢也隨之破滅……氣氛徹底毀了，你氣沖沖地離開，正打算解散公會，卻突然被追上來的華戀叫住。也許，今天還沒那麼糟……與如此火辣的辣妹單獨去卡拉OK包廂，只能說明一件事：她絕對看上你了，你們就要好、好、親、熱、了！

又或者……她只是想從你身上撈點快錢，拿去遊戲裡課金。真掃興……既然與女玩家們建立溫馨幸福後宮的希望已經徹底落空，那就親自出手，讓公會成員們乖乖聽話，連現實中也開始喊你「主人」吧！
